title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function | TechCrunch
summary: In its latest earnings call, co-founder and CEO Brian Chesky said AI is helping Airbnb create features at rapid rate. Chesky said during the earnings call that the company will finally start testing AI search.
